input.summary: Add Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity, indemnity procedure and IP remedies (Section 20.5); narrow Customer's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently contains only a broad Customer indemnity in Vendor's favour, so we added Vendor's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, together with standard claim procedure and the infringement remedies Section 9.3 already assumes exist in Section 20.5. We also narrowed Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law; if needed, we can discuss a 3x annual Fees super-cap on Vendor's indemnity as a fallback.

ops.oldText: 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from and against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (a) content or materials Customer provides to Vendor for use in the Services, or (b) Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: 20.2 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. 20.3 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim, tender control of the defence and settlement, and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense; no settlement imposing a non-monetary obligation on, or an admission by, the indemnified Party may be made without its written consent, and the indemnified Party may participate with its own counsel at its own expense. 20.4 Vendor's obligation under Section 20.2(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's modification of the Services or Deliverables contrary to Vendor's documentation, combination with materials not supplied or recommended by Vendor, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications. 20.5 If a claim described in Section 20.2(a) arises or is reasonably likely, Vendor shall, at its expense, procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected item or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent, non-infringing item. If Vendor cannot do so within thirty days, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and receive a refund of Fees paid for them, including prepaid Fees for the terminated period.
